text:
ava-partners: Heads-up: kicking off a focused run for cloud marketplace onboarding. primary goals: staging publisher setup, SKU CSV with co-brand flag, AMI/GCE image validation, and legal artifact checklist. who can take what?

ryan-eng: I can do publisher account automation + image checks. will create a small verification tool that pings AMI/image availability across regions.

meera-legal: i'll draft the minimal legal bundle we need for listings: short EULA excerpt, privacy blurb, marketing approval steps, and any export control notes. will need the product description to redline.

zack-ops: staging-bot created cloud-catalog-staging (account id: 111222333). please add the publisher role. ping me when automation is ready to test. :white_check_mark:

staging-bot: Created staging publisher account cloud-catalog-staging. remember to attach publisher-role before publishing to staging.

ryan-eng: quick sample verify script i'll run and push results: ```bash
REGIONS=(us-east-1 us-west-2 eu-central-1 ap-southeast-1)
for r in "${REGIONS[@]}"; do
  aws ec2 describe-images --region "$r" --image-ids "$AMI" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "$AMI missing in $r"
done
```

ava-partners: For SKU mapping: want CSV columns: sku_id, sku_name, product_id, plan_tier, trial_days, free_quota_tokens, co_brand_required(true/false). can someone create the first pass?

sophie-pm: i'll mock naming conventions and price tiers. recommending: Free (10k tokens/mo), Trial(14d), Standard(monthly), Enterprise(contact). will put sample customer-facing strings.

meera-legal: note: avoid HIPAA/PCI claims unless we have formal agreements. also need SOC2 and privacy statement links for marketplace listing meta.

ryan-eng: noted. also flagging image replication delays are common. plan to add a verification timestamp per region and a fallback AMI mapping if replication fails.

ava-partners: ops question: do we bundle region-specific artifacts into one package or separate per region?

zack-ops: usually one listing with per-region asset references. marketplace publish UI accepts per-region image or snapshot IDs. we'll generate a manifest.json with region->image mapping.

ryan-eng: sample manifest snippet i'll produce: ```json
{"us-east-1":"ami-0abc123","eu-central-1":"ami-0def456"}
```

meera-legal: i'll add a line in the checklist: confirm asset ownership and trademark approvals for any co-branded material. loop partner-legal if external logos used.

ava-partners: timeline suggestion: day 0 owners assigned, day 1 SKU CSV + manifest, day 2 legal drafts, day 3 staging publish dry-run, day 4 review + prod publish.

sophie-pm: i'll coordinate a 30-min dry-run on day 3 and invite all owners.

zack-ops: reminder: there is a staging quota on image creations. if we need new snapshots, schedule early.

ryan-eng: will run verification now and paste results here.

(30m later)

ryan-eng: verification results: us-east-1 OK, us-west-2 OK, eu-central-1 delayed (replication pending), ap-southeast-1 missing. filing follow-up to request replication and will add fallback images.

ava-partners: thanks. updating tracking sheet: https://docs.internal/redwood/marketplace-onboard-alpha -- please add manifest and CSV links.

meera-legal: added legal checklist and sample EULA excerpt to the doc.

staging-bot: Reminder: run publisher dry-run step in cloud-catalog-staging with the manifest attached to avoid surprises.

ava-partners: great work. if the eu/ap images don't replicate by EOD we'll use region fallbacks and note the limitation in the listing. next check-in tomorrow 10:30am.
